LightningComponentBundle.description: Light end-of-flow completion screen for Contact-based POC notes flows — same look as the voice and final analysis components.

property.name: message
property.label: Message
property.description: Main line shown under the checkmark (e.g. that notes capture or analysis finished).

property.name: titleGrad
property.label: Title (gradient part)
property.description: Second title segment with the purple/cyan gradient.

property.name: badge
property.label: Status badge (optional)
property.description: Optional pill on the right, e.g. 'Analysis done' — leave empty to hide.

property.name: subtext
property.label: Subtext (optional)
property.description: Smaller line under the main message; optional.
